text:
Lina CS: FYI BlueCurrent's SEARCH team just flipped on multi-tenant semantic search across 3 squads. Embedding write rate jumped ~8x around 11:03 ET. Seeing queueing on hosted endpoints. :warning:
Evan CSE: yep saw the spike in traces. They've doubled context to 8k tokens for richer rerank. Might be hitting KV cache eviction.
Lina CS: onboarding note: they skipped the advanced perf session last month. They asked about private deploy for PII last quarter. If latency stays bad, renewal chatter could shift.
Priya AM: renewal window 2026-09-02. This is a clear expansion signal but also churn risk. Can we triage quickly and pitch a staged dedicated plan?
Evan CSE: quick plan: 1) confirm model & quant profile 2) enable prefix + per-customer KV 3) suggest batched embedding write path
Jordan SRE: I can provision a test dedicated slice (2x) for them. Need approval; can be live in ~90m.
Lina CS: can we get a short cost estimate to include in the enablement invite? Procurement will want numbers.
Evan CSE: rough: 2x ded slice ~= $2.8k/mo, 6x ~= $7.4k/mo. I'll produce a matrix with GPU types by EOD.
scaling-bot: alert: bluecurrent-prod embeddings queue depth > 250 for 12m. Notified oncall. <https://console.redwood.ai/alerts/REDACTED>
Jordan SRE: Oncall reports intermittent OOM on embedding-writer; rerouted traffic at 11:25. Logs in #eng-runtime.
Lina CS: booking a technical workshop Thurs 9:30am ET for teams + infra. Need someone from runtime to demo batching and KV tuning. Priya, can you add this to the renewal collateral?
Priya AM: will add a 'migration + uplift' slide and a one-pager on expected latency improvements. Also want an FAQ about data residency for the private option.
Evan CSE: I'll demo a sample batch config and a quick script to switch to batched writes:
```
POST /v1/clients/bluecurrent/config
{ "batch_embeddings": true, "batch_size": 128, "kv_namespace": "bluecurrent-v1" }
```
Lina CS: collect product feedback: they said the Console shows ambiguous error codes when batch backpressure happens. Ticket #ENG-4321 created.
Priya AM: Action items:
- Evan: perf matrix + batched write demo (due today EOD)
- Jordan: provision test slice + run synthetic tests (in progress)
- Priya: update renewal collateral + residency FAQ
- Lina: send customer update with expected schedules
Jordan SRE: test slice up: 10.44.2.77. Running synthetic embed writer @2k/s, will report tail latency numbers.
Lina CS: thanks all. I'll flag this as an upsell in CRM and set a reminder for a mid-week check-in. :thumbsup:
